book.title: Reserve your stay
book.subtitle: Live availability, clear pricing, and secure payment after your booking request.
book.searchHint: Choose a check-in within three months and a stay of up to 30 nights.
book.detailsHint: A nickname holds the room and your email carries the confirmation. Your legal name is collected at check-in.

book.dailyCleaning: I would like daily room cleaning
book.coveredInFull: Your complimentary nights cover this stay in full — there is nothing to pay.
book.payAfterSubmit: You can choose your payment method after submitting your booking request.

book.creditsHint_other: You have {{count}} free nights for {{room}}. Choose which nights to cover.
book.creditsAtLimit: That is all {{count}} of your free nights for this room type. Uncheck one to move it to a different night.
book.consentRequired: Please read and accept the Booking Terms and the Privacy Notice to continue.
